Python AES-GCM event decrypts in actual JavaScript Device client

deviceClient.environment: Actual Hub JavaScript WebCrypto client ↔ Python adapter via localhost RAM relay; fictional messages, no carrier

passed: Pairing generates role-separated credentials and owner-only files; relay has no encryption key
Relay rejects bad bearer tokens and unapproved browser origins
Relay routes only to the opposite role and expires RAM envelopes
Relay payload contains ciphertext rather than readable message text
Adapter ignores tampered ciphertext

Mac send remains disabled without explicit authorization
